status.principle: An always-run audit needs a terminal state even when integration inputs are absent.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict states adopted, blocked, partial, null, or disqualified disposition with a terminal prefix.

verdict_class.principle: The closed class prevents audit circularity or missing inputs from becoming a positive claim.

input_existence_and_hash_receipts.principle: The audit identifies the exact artifacts and binaries it evaluated.

independent_build_identity_receipt.principle: A fresh native build check prevents Python fallback from posing as Rust execution.

independent_disabled_identity_rows.principle: Fresh native-versus-disabled rows test the central default-off promise.

independent_enabled_and_parity_rows.principle: Fresh route and binding rows prevent self-audit by copied upstream outcomes.

independent_exact_equality_receipt.principle: Production adoption requires unchanged exact accepted outputs.

fallback_exception_and_rollback_audit.principle: The audit covers every safety escape and persistent-state boundary.

independent_cost_recomputation.principle: Adapter, FFI, and fallback overhead are charged from raw clocks.

missing_input_disposition.principle: Absent or partial upstream work closes honestly instead of producing null rows.

shortcut_attack_matrix.principle: Independent attacks test identities, candidate preservation, mutation, and build substitution.

production_safety_net_audited_ready_scor.principle: A binary independent score defines whether production integration may be adopted.

per_unit_rows.principle: Every comparative audit conclusion is recomputable per unit.

aggregate_row_recomputation.principle: The adoption decision derives from audit rows only.

gate_check_summary.principle: A blocked audit lists missing or failed checks and observed values.

preconditions_checked.principle: Input and toolchain receipts distinguish a block from a scientific null.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: The audit does not repair evidence or mutate protected orchestration files.

inference_substrate.principle: Independent deterministic replay is not mislabeled as live GGUF inference.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: The audit checks integration and exact equality; the learned router is not ground truth.

field_provenance.principle: Every headline field identifies independent rows and recomputation code.

random_seed.principle: A fixed audit sample makes the disposition reproducible.

duration_s.principle: Monotonic duration catches audits that never ran their native checks.

tests_run.principle: Named commands and exits prove independent validation ran.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A final hash protects the audit determination trail.
